title: Schemaless graph
statement: The system shall accept nodes and edges with any labels, edge types and properties, and edges between nodes of any labels, without a predeclared graph type.
rationale: PO decision: schemaless; any node may link to any node with any label.

acceptance_criteria.text: On an empty database, inserting nodes with previously unseen labels and an edge of a previously unseen type between them succeeds without any DDL.

notes: Consequence: no enforcement of allowed endpoints, cardinality or required properties; applications own data shape.
